movies.title: Breaking Bad
movies.description: A high school chemistry teacher diagnosed with inoperable lung cancer turns to manufacturing and selling methamphetamine in order to secure his family's future.

movies.title: Spider-man
movies.description: When bitten by a modified spider, a nerdy, shy, and awkward high school student gains spider-like abilities that he eventually must use to fight evil as a superhero after tragedy befalls his family.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
movies.description: The movie follows Peter Parker as he balances his dual identity of a budding superhero while navigating the everyday life of a teenager in high school. Peter must soon put his powers to the test when the evil Vulture emerges to threaten everything that he holds dear.

movies.title: The Amazing Spider-man
movies.description: The Amazing Spider-Man had several differences compared to the previous section is that this part focused on the differences in the personalities of the characters. Peter is no longer the shy boy, but quite naughty, besides the director Marc Webb also make more changes in the content to make Amazing Spider-Man really new compared to the old version.

movies.title: Lorne
movies.description: An unprecedented, behind-the-scenes glimpse at the man who built the inimitable empire of comedy, shaping television and culture for generations. The documentary features exclusive footage, archival treasures, and candid interviews with the show’s most iconic cast members and writers including Tina Fey, Maya Rudolph, John Mulaney, Andy Samberg, Conan O’Brien, Chris Rock and many more.

movies.title: Eating Up Easter
movies.description: The Rapanui community on Easter Island fights to prevent an environmental collapse due to overwhelming tourism and industrial progress, and to preserve their cultural traditions.

movies.title: Dummy
movies.description: Archibald the Amazing, a ventriloquist nearing the end of his career, gives one final performance with his dummy, Chucklehead. After the show, he tragically takes his own life in his hotel room-but his negative energy inhabits Chucklehead, transforming the dummy into a murderous force of terror. From a class reunion to hotel staff to unsuspecting bystanders, Chucklehead embarks on a blood-soaked rampage, vowing to make it a night to remember.

movies.title: Teddiscare
movies.description: A killer mutated teddy bear film from Mark Polonia.

movies.title: The Truman Show
movies.description: The Truman Show is a science fiction film in 1998, directed by Peter Weir. The film recounts the life of a young man does not know that there is a television program to be broadcast live to billions of people around the world to see.

movies.title: Avatar: Fire and Ash
movies.description: In the wake of the devastating war against the RDA and the loss of their eldest son, Jake Sully and Neytiri face a new threat on Pandora: the Ash People, a violent and power-hungry Na’vi tribe led by the ruthless Varang. Jake’s family must fight for their survival and the future of Pandora in a conflict that pushes them to their emotional and physical limits.

movies.title: The Rip
movies.description: After a team of Miami cops discovers millions in cash inside a derelict stash house, trust frays as everything — and everyone — is called into question.

movies.title: The Accountant 2
movies.description: When an old acquaintance is murdered, Wolff is compelled to solve the case. Realizing more extreme measures are necessary, Wolff recruits his estranged and highly lethal brother, Brax, to help. In partnership with Treasury Agent Marybeth Medina, they uncover a deadly conspiracy, becoming targets of a ruthless network of killers who will stop at nothing to keep their secrets buried.

movies.title: The Accountant
movies.description: The Accountant is a 2016 American crime thriller film following a highly-functioning autistic small-town certified public accountant who makes his living uncooking the books of dangerous criminal organizations that are experiencing internal embezzlement.

movies.title: Self-Help
movies.description: A young woman infiltrates a dangerous self-actualization community after her mother becomes entangled with its enigmatic leader.

movies.title: Avatar
movies.description: Avatar revolves around the journey of explorer - Jake Sully (Sam Worthington). He is a former naval officer who is wounded in a battle on Earth and then lower body is paralyzed. Jake is selected to participate in the project Avatar, this program is conducted to implant human genes into Na’vi natives to help people easily expose and research Pandora and the Na’vi.

movies.title: Aliens
movies.description: After floating in space for 57 years, Lt. Ripley’s shuttle is found by a deep space salvage team. Upon arriving at LV-426, the marines find only one survivor, a nine year old girl named Newt . But even these battle-hardened marines with all the latest weaponry are no match for the hundreds of aliens that have invaded the colony.

movies.title: The Terminator
movies.description: The Terminator (Also Known As: Ke Huy Diet ) is an Action, Sci-Fi film directed by James Cameron and written by Gale Anne Hurd, . It was released on 26 October 1984 (USA). It stars Arnold Schwarzenegger, Linda Hamilton, Michael Biehn. The film’s content : A seemingly indestructible humanoid cyborg is sent from 2029 to 1984 to assassinate a waitress, whose unborn son will lead humanity in a war against the machines, while a soldier from that war is sent to protect her at all costs.. What awaits ahead ? Enjoy the film and discover by yourself.

movies.title: The Whisper
movies.description: Fleeing from their violent father, siblings Lucía and Adrián take refuge in a remote mansion. With the help of a hidden micro-camera on a cat, Lucía uncovers a terrifying secret: their neighbors are part of a criminal network that kidnaps teenage girls to make snuff films, and they intend to get rid of the siblings. As Lucía fights to protect her brother, she must face a dark family curse that follows them into their newfound sanctuary.

movies.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
movies.description: Having thwarted Bowser’s previous plot to marry Princess Peach, Mario and Luigi now face a fresh threat in Bowser Jr., who is determined to liberate his father from captivity and restore the family legacy. Alongside companions new and old, the brothers travel across the stars to stop the young heir’s crusade.

movies.title: Monster: The Prehistoric Project
movies.description: Two Navy SEALS are sent to an abandoned island to retrieve a package, but instead of being the hunters, they find they are being hunted. They find a camera in the hands of a dead man, and they learn they are being stalked by a giant predator.

movies.title: The Twisters
movies.description: A deadly patchwork of destructive cyclones is on an apocalyptic path of convergence at a populated Midwest city center. There, the twisters will merge into one mega tornado that threatens to obliterate the cities for hundreds of miles around.

movies.title: Gladiator II
movies.description: Years after witnessing the death of the revered hero Maximus at the hands of his uncle, Lucius is forced to enter the Colosseum after his home is conquered by the tyrannical Emperors who now lead Rome with an iron fist. With rage in his heart and the future of the Empire at stake, Lucius must look to his past to find strength and honor to return the glory of Rome to its people.

movies.title: Gladiator
movies.description: Maximus is a powerful Roman general, loved by the people and the aging Emperor, Marcus Aurelius. Before his death, the Emperor chooses Maximus to be his heir over his own son, Commodus, and a power struggle leaves Maximus and his family condemned to death. The powerful general is unable to save his family, and his loss of will allows him to get captured and put into the Gladiator games until he dies. The only desire that fuels him now is the chance to rise to the top so that he will be able to look into the eyes of the man who will feel his revenge.

movies.title: Home Alone
movies.description: In Chicago, the McCallister family is preparing for a Christmas vacation in Paris. On the night before their departure, the entire family gathers at Peter and Kate’s home, where their son, Kevin, is ridiculed by his siblings and cousins

movies.title: Home Alone 2: Lost In New York
movies.description: In Chicago, Illinois, the McCallister family is preparing for a Christmas vacation in Miami. On the night before their departure, the entire family gathers at Peter and Kate’s home, where their 10-year-old son Kevin sees Florida as contradictory to Christmas because he thinks there are no Christmas trees in Florida.

movies.title: Swapped
movies.description: A tiny woodland creature and a majestic bird suddenly swap bodies, forcing them to team up to survive the wildest adventure of their lives.

movies.title: The Ice Age Adventures of Buck Wild
movies.description: The fearless one-eyed weasel Buck teams up with mischievous possum brothers Crash & Eddie as they head off on a new adventure into Buck's home: The Dinosaur World.

movies.title: Jurassic World 2015
movies.description: The film revolves around the story of a deceased doctor's discovery that changed humanity about recovering DNA from giant reptiles survived millions of years. Dinosaurs in turn are revived through DNA of the fossilized mosquitoes' blood . Gradually they develop into a conservation park and want to turn it into a world park.

movies.title: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom
movies.description: Three years after the destruction of the Jurassic World theme park, Owen Grady and Claire Dearing return to the island of Isla Nublar to save the remaining dinosaurs from a volcano that's about to erupt. They soon encounter terrifying new breeds of gigantic dinos while uncovering a conspiracy that threatens the entire planet.

movies.title: Jurassic World Rebirth
movies.description: The film revolves around a skilled covert operations team embarking on a high-stakes mission to secure genetic material from the world's largest remaining dinosaurs. Five years after the events of Dominion, the planet's ecology has become inhospitable to these prehistoric creatures, leaving them isolated in tropical environments. The team's quest for a life-saving breakthrough uncovers a shocking conspiracy that has been hidden from the world for decades.

movies.title: Jurassic World: Dominion
movies.description: Four years after the destruction of Isla Nublar, dinosaurs now live and hunt alongside humans all over the world. This fragile balance will reshape the future and determine, once and for all, whether human beings are to remain the apex predators on a planet they now share with history's most fearsome creatures in a new era of coexistence.

movies.title: Transformers
movies.description: About 4 million years ago, on a distant planet Cybertron exists a civilization of robots which was ravaged by war lasted for centuries between the two sides of robotics: autobot and deception. They fight to gain Allspark - things have the ability to bring the ultimate power to those who possess it. And then the Earth accidentally catch up in the fierce battle with the destructive weapons which two races can variously transform from the vehicles to the massive destruction machines …

movies.title: Transformers: The Last Knight
movies.description: Humans are at wars with the Transformers while Optimus Prime is absent. The only way to save the humanity is lying in the secrets of the past and the hidden history of Transformers on Earth and our heroes are the only hope to save the day.

movies.title: Transformers: Revenge Of The Fallen
movies.description: Content of Transformers: Revenge Of The Fallen: Deceptico returnes to Earth with a chasing target - Sam Witwicky, after he accidentally knew the secret of The Transfiguration and their ancient history. With a mission to protect humankind, leader Optimus Prime set up an international military alliance to be ready for the 2nd glorious fight

movies.title: Kraken
movies.description: Marine biologist Johanne is doing research on a fish farm in Vangsnes, a rural community located by the fjord, when she encounters several strange occurrences. Along with the brutal deaths of two local teenagers, all signs point to the deep fjord; can there be more to the depths than the eye can see? At the bottom of the deepest fjord rests a mythical monster as large as a mountain, with a myriad of arms ready to crush and devour anything they can grab.

movies.title: The Meg
movies.description: Jonas Taylor, a rescue diver, attempts to save a group of scientists, from a pre-historic 75-foot-long shark known as the Megalodon that is terrorizing a beach.

movies.title: Meg 2: The Trench
movies.description: The film follows a daring research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest reaches of the ocean. Their voyage spirals into chaos when a malevolent mining operation threatens their mission and forces them into a high-stakes battle for survival. Pitted against colossal Megs and relentless environmental plunderers, the heroes must outrun, outsmart, and outswim their merciless predators in a pulse-pounding race against time.

movies.title: Mercy
movies.description: In the near future, a detective stands on trial accused of murdering his wife. He has ninety minutes to prove his innocence to the advanced AI Judge he once championed, before it determines his fate.

movies.title: Migration
movies.description: After a migrating duck family alights on their pond with thrilling tales of far-flung places, the Mallard family embarks on a family road trip, via New York City, to tropical Jamaica.

movies.title: Rampage (2018)
movies.description: As three different animals infected with a dangerous pathogen tear across North America, destroying everything in their path, a primatologist and a geneticist team up to stop them from destroying Chicago.

movies.title: Jurassic Park III
movies.description: The story of a mysterious island with dinosaurs still attracts so many people to discover, this time the couple Kirby. House Kirby with a paleontologist - Alan Grant visit the island. Unfortunately, their plane is broken and they have to fight with the bloodthirsty dinosaurs.

movies.title: Jurassic Park II: The Lost World
movies.description: After heavy defeat at Nublar, dinosaur park was completely destroyed after a storm. John continued to organize the 2nd study trip at Sona island. Indeed, this is where nurture and hatch dinosaur eggs. During this trip with Dr. Sara Harding, Dr. Ian Malcolm's girlfriend. He didn't know that she comes sorna island, realize that this trip is very dangerous because Ian had been on the island Nublar, he decided to venture to the island to bring Laura back. Until reaching the island, he finds the truth that this is actually a large-scale dinosaur hunt, to catch them bring San Francisco where a new dinosaur park is being built.

movies.title: Jurassic Park
movies.description: On a secret island, the dinosaur recreation work is completed by the rest DNA on the ancient mosquito. Before opening his park, Mr. Hammond invited a group of scientists come to visit and help him. But in a stormy night, the protection system collapses, the ancient giant beast escape…

movies.title: Firebreak
movies.description: Little Lide disappears in the forest while her family packs up their home. As a fire breaks out, her mother must race to reach her before the flames do.

movies.title: GOAT
movies.description: A small goat with big dreams gets a once-in-a-lifetime shot to join the pros and play roarball, a high-intensity, co-ed, full-contact sport dominated by the fastest, fiercest animals in the world.

movies.title: Crime 101
movies.description: When an elusive thief whose high-stakes heists unfold along the iconic 101 freeway in Los Angeles eyes the score of a lifetime, with hopes of this being his final job, his path collides with a disillusioned insurance broker who is facing her own crossroads. Determined to crack the case, a relentless detective closes in on the operation, raising the stakes even higher.

movies.title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
movies.description: Dr. Kelson finds himself in a shocking new relationship - with consequences that could change the world as they know it - and Spike's encounter with Jimmy Crystal becomes a nightmare he can't escape.

movies.title: Scream 7
movies.description: When a new Ghostface killer emerges in the quiet town where Sidney Prescott has built a new life, her darkest fears are realized as her daughter becomes the next target. Determined to protect her family, Sidney must face the horrors of her past to put an end to the bloodshed once and for all.

movies.title: Predator: Badlands
movies.description: Cast out from his clan, a young Predator finds an unlikely ally in a damaged android and embarks on a treacherous journey in search of the ultimate adversary.

movies.title: Hoppers
movies.description: Scientists have discovered how to 'hop' human consciousness into lifelike robotic animals, allowing people to communicate with animals as animals. Animal lover Mabel seizes an opportunity to use the technology, uncovering mysteries within the animal world beyond anything she could have imagined.

movies.title: Project Hail Mary
movies.description: Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up on a spaceship light years from home with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction… but an unexpected friendship means he may not have to do it alone.
